title: ax.config
description: Fork-receiver project layout config consumed by ax-transform installer skills and the ax/* ESLint plugin (react.* is injected as ESLint flat-config settings.ax verbatim).

stacks.description: Which stacks this project uses (e.g. react, java).

react.description: Shape matches layoutFrom()'s expected settings.ax input in practices-react/eslint-plugin-ax/lib/feature-layout.js.

root.description: Repo-relative path to the React app root (e.g. frontend).

srcDir.description: Top-level source directory name, relative to react.root (e.g. src). Must be a single path segment — a multi-segment path (e.g. 'a/b') is rejected. This pattern is the schema-time check; layoutFrom() in feature-layout.js additionally throws at lint runtime if a multi-segment value reaches it (e.g. a hand-edited config that bypassed this schema), since it would otherwise silently no-op every layer-boundary rule instead of erroring.

root.description: Repo-relative path to the Spring Boot app root (e.g. backend).

rootPackage.description: Base Java package for the project.

useCatalog.description: Whether to apply the ax design-system catalog.

excludeTags.description: practices rule tags to exclude from consumption.
